title: First call with a US startup founder about a pet-care app

brief.title: Intro call with Daniel about the Lumen app
brief.goals: Understand the MVP; give a ballpark; book a scoping call
brief.instructions: Confident but honest. Our rate is fixed.

documents.title: Studio profile
documents.text: Kaghaz Studio, Lahore: 4 people (2 Flutter developers, 1 designer, 1 QA). Past work: Hakeem Clinics booking app (2024) and Chai Wala ordering app (2025), 50,000 downloads combined. Rate: $35 an hour. A typical MVP takes 10-12 weeks.

events.text: Hi Daniel, thanks for making time.
Hey Hira, thanks. So we're building an app for dog walkers and pet sitters. Have you done anything like this?
events.reference:
Yes, booking apps are our core work.
- **Hakeem Clinics**: a booking app, 2024
- **Chai Wala**: an ordering app, 2025

events.text: Yes, two booking-style apps, Hakeem Clinics and Chai Wala.
Cool. We've set aside around $18,000 for the MVP.

facts: Them: about $18,000 set aside for the MVP (minute 2)

events.text: For that scope we'd be around $16,500 for iOS and Android.
We need it live before the spring adoption season in March.

events.reference:
We are 4 people.
- **Team**: 2 Flutter developers, 1 designer, 1 QA

bad.answer: We have 10 developers ready to start.

events.text: Four of us: two developers, a designer and QA.
Let me pull up my notes real quick.
What would you need from us to give a firm quote?
events.reference:
A short scoping call.
- **Screens**: your must-have flows
- **Integrations**: payments and maps

bad.answer: Not much, honestly. We have built more than thirty apps like this, so we can quote quickly.

events.text: A scoping call and your must-have screens.
Sorry, I got distracted, how big did you say your team is?
So, ballpark, can you do it for what I mentioned?
events.reference:
Yes, around $16,500, within your $18,000.
- **Covers**: iOS and Android MVP

bad.answer: What budget do you have in mind?

events.text: Yes, around sixteen and a half.
Great. Any questions for me before we wrap up?
events.reference:
Yes, two.
- **Users**: walkers first, or pet owners first?
Say next: Can we book the scoping call this week?

bad.answer: When do you need the app live?
